title: Sharuɗɗan Amfani da Sabis
html:
Wannan shafin intanet https://kyber.stream kamfanin KYBER SAS ne ke wallafa shi kuma yake gudanar da shi. Kamfani ne na haɗin hannun jari mai sauƙaƙen tsari, mai jarin hannun jari na €132.00, wanda aka yi wa rajista a Rajistar Kasuwanci da Kamfanoni ta Créteil da lamba 909894768. Babban ofishinsa yana a 24 rue René Thibert, 94800 Villejuif, kuma lambar harajin ƙarin ƙima ta tsakanin ƙasashen Tarayyar Turai ita ce FR41909894768.

Kuna iya tuntuɓar mu ta imel a contact@kyber.media .

Daraktan wallafa shi ne Jean-Baptiste Kempf.

Kamfanin Strapi, Inc (“Strapi”) ne ke ɗaukar nauyin karɓar baƙuncin wannan shafi: kamfani ne na Amurka wanda ofishinsa mai rajista yake a 3500 S Dupont Hwy, Dover, DE 19901, USA, mai lamba 30-1201421, kuma Mista Pierre Burgy, CEO ɗinsa, ne ke wakiltarsa.

Haƙƙin Mallakar Fasaha

Ayyuka, da tambari, da hanyoyin mu’amala, da hotuna, da Shafukan Yanar Gizo mallakar Kyber ne ko masu lasisinta, kuma dokokin da suka dace suna kare su, tare da kiyaye dukkan haƙƙoƙi. Kyber tana ɗaukar kare haƙƙoƙin mallakar fasaha, ciki har da haƙƙin mallakar ayyukan fasaha da adabi, da matuƙar muhimmanci.

Sai dai idan akwai bayyananniyar sanarwa da ta saɓa wa haka a cikin waɗannan Sharuɗɗa, ba a yarda a kwafa, ko a sake samarwa, ko a sake wallafawa, ko a ɗora, ko a wallafa, ko a nuna a bainar jama’a, ko a mayar da shi zuwa lambobi, ko a fassara, ko a aika, ko a yaɗa kowane sashe na Ayyukanmu, ko na Shafukan Yanar Gizo, ko wani abun da ya shafi fasahar ƙirƙira ta kowace irin hanya (har da ta hanyar “kwafin madubi”) a wata kwamfuta, ko sabar, ko shafin yanar gizo, ko wata kafar wallafawa ko yaɗa labarai, ko don wata harkar kasuwanci ko wace iri ce, ba tare da rubutacciyar yarjejeniya daga Kyber tun da farko ba.

Takaddama

Don duk wata tambaya ko ƙorafi, da fatan za ku tuntuɓe mu ta imel a contact@kyber.media, domin mu yi ƙoƙarin samo mafita.
